The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the final scores are slightly lower than ideal. This suggests that the interaction may be mediated through palmarumycin CP18, though the exact nature of the interaction between mitomycin and SCAK1 remains unclear. The evidence is consistent with a mechanistic pathway, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and the role of SCAK1 in this process.
